text:
maria: Quick check — changelog cutoff for the DevEx release is TOMORROW 18:00 PT. Who still has sample apps / quickstarts / SDK docs to finish? Please call out blockers and owners. :calendar:

kevin: I have the Go quickstart tests failing on the new client auth flow. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/4321 — need a runtime change from eng-runtime (cc @lee). ETA 6h if API stays stable.

lee: Got it. Runtime plan is to ship a patch today at 15:30 PT, but it's gated by a perf regression check. If it passes, I can push the change and tag it 'runtime-v2.3.1'.

sam: Docs note: the Go quickstart snippet needs the auth.env var update. I can patch docs once the runtime tag is out. Leaving it blocked for now. :memo:

toni: I'm owner for the sampleapp 'conversations-demo' — I still need to update the streaming example to function-calling, should be <4h work but depends on the SDK bump in the PR above.

maria: Action items:
- @lee to push runtime patch (or report fail) by 15:45 PT
- @kevin to rebase PR and mark ready-for-merge after runtime tag
- @sam to hold docs edits until runtime tag is confirmed
- @toni to finish sampleapp changes after SDK bump

release-bot: Release window reminder: Changelog cutoff in 24h. Add entries to CHANGES.md under 'Unreleased' or they'll be missed.

kevin: Small changelog blurb draft for my PR:
- Fix: Go quickstart auth flow to support new client auth (PR#4321) — kevin

maria: Perfect. If anything slips past cutoff, we gate to the next minor. Please update here with 'done' or 'blocked' so I can update the release board. :eyes:

lee: I'll post results of perf check in 30m.

kevin: rebased & tests running, will ping when green. :thumbsup:

sam: prepping docs PR template now.

toni: sampleapp updated, awaiting SDK release. marking blocked -> will ping when unblocked.

maria: Thanks — noted. I'll close the loop on the release board.
